cls: Looks like you could benefit from using the "Format" function on the description.
I think you could just adjust `y` instead? If this isn't strictly needed (which I assume it isn't).
I think you should move this conversion into the branches that need it and turn `local_bounds` into a `gfx::RectF`. Then the "need" for `FastAndLossyFromRectF` goes away.
Can you add an explicit test that the document.scrollingElement.scrollParent() is null just to make clear that there is no repeating scroll parent?
Can you add a test of quirks mode where the body element is the document.scrollingElement? Probably this means adding a second test file with the one test - which is fine.
Probably better to just have the spec prose here (since that's the strategy otherwise used in this function). Bug-references are pretty opaque when reading code.
This should probably also reference issue 414808394
This doesn't add much. Maybe instead say that this implements the resolution from https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/issues/12731 ?
